title: The figures the shop sells
summary: Figures in TCG Card Shop Simulator are a stock line of their own: the build names a set of them with an icon each, an evolved version beside several of them, podiums to stand them on and a larger statue set that runs past the dragons.
body: Figures are a line of stock rather than decoration. The build names a set of them with an icon each, a bat, a beetle, a fox, a golem, a piggy, a starfish and a toon among them, which is why what you sell is a defined range rather than one generic ornament.

Each family comes in versions. More than one of these creatures is named in several forms with an evolved one beside them, so a shelf of figures can show a range without the game inventing a second product line for it.

They stand on something. The podiums are named as objects of their own, with a dark and a dark shiny material for them, which is why a figure arrives as a piece with a base rather than as a lump of painted plastic.
The podium has artwork of its own as well, so what a figure stands on is drawn rather than left as bare geometry.

There is a larger set beside the small ones. The statue set runs past the dragons: a beetle, a shellfish, a fox, a tree and a wisp are named among them, so a shop can fill a corner with figures at more than one size.
Some of the set has more than one state. Shiny versions of several statues are named beside the ordinary ones, which is why two shops can hold the same creature and not look alike.
The image beside this entry is the game's own: the icons it ships for two of its figures.
What this entry does not tell you: what any figure costs, how many are in the set, or whether customers prefer one creature to another. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: The figures are shipped as their own set with an icon each: a bat, a beetle, a fox, a golem, a piggy, a starfish and a toon among them.
facts.evidence: asset names: Icon_Toy_BatB, Icon_Toy_Beetle, Icon_Toy_FoxB, Icon_Toy_GolemB, Icon_Toy_PiggyB, Icon_Toy_StarfishB, Icon_Toy_ToonZ

facts.claim: Several of the families are named in more than one version, with an evolved form beside them.
facts.evidence: asset names: Icon_Toy_PiggyEvo, Icon_Toy_StarfishEvo, Icon_Toy_BatD, Icon_Toy_GolemD

facts.claim: The figures stand on podiums of their own, named with a dark and a dark shiny material.
The podium has a sheet of its own in the build.
The statue set runs past the dragons: a beetle, a shellfish, a fox, a tree and a wisp are named among them.
facts.evidence: asset names: Interactable_MonsterStatue_Beetle, Interactable_MonsterStatue_ShellfishD, Interactable_MonsterStatue_FoxD, Interactable_MonsterStatue_TreeD, Interactable_MonsterStatue_Wisp

facts.claim: There is a single statue mesh of its own for one of the bats.
One group inside the set is sea life: starfish named to four, a jellyfish and three shark fish beside them, with an evolution tree mesh for the starfish line.
facts.evidence: asset names: StarfishA, StarfishB, StarfishC, StarfishD, Jellyfish, SharkFishA, SharkFishB, SharkFishC, StarfishEvoTree_Mesh

facts.claim: Two of the sea-life pieces are carried again as ghosts, and some of them have an idle pose named beside them.
facts.evidence: asset names: Ghost_FishD, Ghost_StarfishD, StarfishA_IdlePose, ShellfishD_IdlePose

facts.claim: Each sea-life piece is carried with its own texture and material, named after the piece.
facts.evidence: asset names: T_StarfishA, MAT_StarfishA, T_StarfishD, MAT_StarfishD

facts.claim: A shiny starfish material and a shellfish material are named beside the ordinary ones, and the fish in the set come as four kinds.
facts.evidence: asset names: MAT_Shinny_StarfishA, MAT_ShellfishD, FishA, FishB, FishC, FishD
